original: ||ānandalaharī||
bhavāni stotuṃ tvāṃ prabhavati caturbhirna vadanaiḥ prajānāmīśānastripuramathanaḥ pañcabhirapi |
analyzed: bhavāni stotum tvām prabhavati caturbhiḥ na vadanaiḥ prajānāmi īśānaḥ tripura mathanaḥ pañcabhiḥ api

original: na ṣaḍbhiḥ senānīrdaśaśatamukhairapyahipatistadāmanyeṣāṃ keṣāṃ kathaya kathamasminnavasaraḥ||1||
analyzed: na ṣaḍbhiḥ senānīḥ daśa śata mukhaiḥ api ahi patiḥ tadām anyeṣām keṣām kathaya katham asmin avasaraḥ

original: ghṛtakṣīradrākṣāmadhumadhurimā kairapi padairviśiṣyānākhyeyo bhavati rasanāmātraviṣayaḥ |

original: tathā te saundaryaṃ paramaśivadṛṅmātraviṣayaḥ kathaṅkāraṃ brūmaḥ sakalanigamāgocaraguṇe||2||

original: mukhe te tāṃbūlaṃ nayanayugale kajjalakalā lalāṭe kāśmīraṃ vilasati gale mauktikalatā |
analyzed: mukhe te tāṃbūlam nayana yugale kajjala kalā lalāṭe kāśmīram vilasati gale mauktika latā

original: sphuratkāñcī śāṭī pṛthukaṭitaṭe hāṭakamayī bhajāmi tvāṃ gaurīṃ nagapatikiśorīmaviratam||3||

original: virājanmandāradrumakusumahārastanataṭīnadadvīṇānādaśravaṇavilasatkuṇḍalaguṇā |
analyzed: virājat mandāra druma kusuma hāra stana taṭī nadat vīṇā nāda śravaṇa vilasat kuṇḍala guṇā

original: natāṅgī mātaṅgī ruciragatibhaṅgī bhagavatī satī śaṃbhoraṃbhoruhacaṭukacakṣurvijayate||4||

original: navīnārkabhrājanmaṇikanakabhūṣāparikarairvṛtāṅgī sāraṅgīruciranayanāṅgīkṛtaśivā |
analyzed: navīna arka bhrājat maṇi kanaka bhūṣā parikaraiḥ vṛta aṅgī sāraṅgī rucira nayana aṅgīkṛta śivā

original: taṭitpītā pītāṃbaralalitamajjīrasubhagā mamāparṇā pūrṇā niravadhisukhairastu sumukhī||5||

original: himādreḥ saṃbhūtā sulalitakaraiḥ pallavayutā supuṣpā muktābhirbhramarakalitā cālakabharaiḥ |
analyzed: himādreḥ saṃbhūtā su lalita karaiḥ pallava yutā supuṣpā muktābhiḥ bhramara kalitā ca alaka bharaiḥ

original: kṛtasthāṇusthānā kucaphalanatā sūktisarasā rujāṃ hantrī gantrī vilasati cidānandalatikā||6||

original: saparṇāmākīrṇāṃ katipayaguṇaiḥ sādaramiha śrayantyanye vallīṃ mama tu matirevaṃ vilasati |
analyzed: sa parṇām ākīrṇām katipaya guṇaiḥ sādaram iha śrayanti anye vallīm mama tu matiḥ evam vilasati

original: aparṇaikā sevyā jagati sakalairyatparivṛtaḥ purāṇo'pi sthāṇuḥ phalati kila kaivalyapadavīm||7||

original: vidhātrī dharmāṇāṃ tvamasi sakalāṃnāyajananī tvamarthānāṃ mūlaṃ dhanadanamanīyāṅ‌ghrikamale |
analyzed: vidhātrī dharmāṇām tvam asi sakala aṃnāya jananī tvam arthānām mūlam dhanada namanīya aṅghri kamale

original: tvamādiḥ kāmānāṃ janani kṛtakandarpavijaye satāṃ mukterbījaṃ tvamasi paramabrahmamahiṣī||8||
analyzed: tvam ādiḥ kāmānām janani kṛta kandarpa vijaye satām mukteḥ bījam tvam asi parama brahma mahiṣī

original: prabhūtā bhaktiste yadapi na mamālolamanasastvayā tu śrīmatyā sadayamavalokyo'hamadhunā |
analyzed: prabhūtā bhaktiḥ te yat api na mama ālola manasaḥ tvayā tu śrīmatyā sat ayam avalokya uham adhunā

original: payodaḥ pānīyaṃ diśati madhuraṃ cātakamukhe bhṛśaṃ śaṅke kairvā vidhibhiranunītā mama matiḥ||9||

original: tathāpi tvacceto yadi mayi na jāyeta sadayaṃ nirālaṃbo laṃbodarajanani kaṃ yāmi śaraṇam||11||

original: tathā tattatpāpairatimalinamantarmama yadi tvayi preṃṇā saktaṃ kathamiva na jāyeta vimalam||12||

original: tvadanyasmādicchāviṣayaphalalābhe na niyamastvamajñānāmicchādhikamapi samarthā vitaraṇe |

original: iti prāhuḥ prāñcaḥ kamalabhavanādyāstvayi manastvadāsaktaṃ naktaṃdivamucitamīśāni kuru tat||13||

original: nivāsaḥ kailāse vidhiśatamakhādyāḥ stutikarāḥ kuṭuṃbaṃ tlokyaṃ kṛtakarapuṭaḥ siddhinikaraḥ |

original: vṛṣo vṛddho yānaṃ viṣamaśanamāśā nivasanaṃ śmaśānaṃ krīḍābhūrbhujaganivaho bhūṣaṇavidhiḥ |
